clue.text: He's always in the red at Christmas!

definitions.text: He's always in the red at Christmas!

parts.words: He's always in the red at Christmas!
parts.note: reads like a man overdrawn at the bank over the festive season, but 'in the red' means dressed in red clothes, the costume of the gift-bringer

explanation.surface: A rueful remark about someone who is permanently overdrawn by the end of December.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the red' wants to mean in debt; here it describes a red suit and hat.
explanation.definitionFit: The festive gift-giver of Christmas legend is always pictured wearing a red coat trimmed with white fur.

clue.text: Brutal strike in a recession

indicators.note: a recession is a going back, so the whole run of pieces is read backwards

parts.note: to lam is to strike or thrash
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A violent blow delivered during an economic downturn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a recession' turns LAM + IN + A, giving LAMINA backwards. 'in' looks like part of the indicator but supplies its own two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Animal as an adjective describes beastly, physical instincts, close to brutal behaviour.

clue.text: Note the revolutionary must be kept in check

parts.note: te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale
taken as written
a red is a revolutionary, a communist

explanation.surface: A warning that some radical must be restrained.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tied up by a rope is restrained, held in check.

clue.text: Issue raised by an American prospector

definitions.text: Issue raised by an American prospector

parts.words: Issue raised by an American prospector
parts.note: issue means offspring, so this is the daughter brought up by a gold-rush miner in the old folk song 'Oh My Darling'

explanation.surface: Sounds like a matter brought up for debate by a gold miner in the American West.
explanation.walkthrough: The American folk song tells of a miner, a forty-niner of the 1849 gold rush, and his daughter. 'Issue raised' pretends to be a topic brought up.
explanation.definitionFit: In the folk song 'Oh My Darling', the heroine is the child of a miner who went prospecting for gold.

clue.text: Wind direction is plain

parts.note: the auster is the south wind, named in classical Latin
E is east, a compass direction

explanation.surface: A forecaster notes that the wind's direction is clear.
explanation.definitionFit: Severe and unadorned design is called plain, without decoration.

clue.text: Pole left holding gold for a one-time leader of Israel

indicators.note: the first pieces contain the next one, holding it between them

parts.note: S is the south pole
Au is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: A Polish man on the left keeps hold of gold for an ancient Israelite king.
explanation.definitionFit: The Old Testament names this figure as the first king of the Israelites.

clue.text: Progressive man using military force no longer

parts.note: RE stands for the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
former means past, no longer so

explanation.surface: Someone forward-thinking who has given up using armed violence.
explanation.walkthrough: RE is the Royal Engineers, a regiment of the British Army.
explanation.definitionFit: A person campaigning for change and improvement in society is a progressive campaigner.

clue.text: The main boy friend at a particular time

parts.note: the main is an old poetic name for the open sea
a son is a boy
an ally is a friend

explanation.surface: A list of seafaring characters: the ocean, a lad, and a companion.
explanation.definitionFit: Something occurring according to the time of year happens only in certain periods.

clue.text: Charge everyone for example a quarter

parts.note: all means everyone
E, east, is one of the four quarters of the compass

explanation.surface: An accusation applied to everybody, illustrated by a quarter of them.
explanation.definitionFit: To accuse or claim without proof is a synonym of to assert something against someone.

clue.text: Having no catalogue, is not really interested

definitions.meaning: lacking a list, read as list plus less

explanation.surface: Someone without a catalogue shows little enthusiasm.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking a list is the literal sense; the everyday meaning is lethargic and without energy.

clue.text: The chests of well-grown youths

definitions.meaning: lads of great height, read literally

explanation.surface: Describes the broad torsos of strapping young men.
explanation.definitionFit: A high chest of drawers bears this name; read literally it describes lofty lads.

clue.text: A slight lack of clarity in speech

explanation.surface: Describes a speaker who mumbles a little.
explanation.definitionFit: An insult cast on someone's reputation, and also words run together indistinctly by a speaker.

clue.text: Turnover resulting from a reversal of policy

definitions.meaning: a complete U-turn in opinion or plans

explanation.surface: A business's turnover changes after the board changes direction.
explanation.definitionFit: A gymnastic head-over-heels flip, and figuratively a complete about-turn in politics.

clue.text: The gardener finding runners may go berserk!

indicators.note: going berserk means running wild, so these letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A gardener discovers his runner beans may grow out of control.
explanation.walkthrough: 'runners' suggests runner beans, fitting the garden picture, but the word is simply anagram fodder with 'may'.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who raises plants for sale in a plant nursery is a professional gardener.

clue.text: Some improvement might be made in tone

indicators.note: the letters might be rearranged into another form, so they are shuffled

explanation.surface: A suggestion that an adjustment of tone could make a piece of writing better.
explanation.definitionFit: A correction to a text is an improvement made by an editor.

clue.text: Tearful woman with nothing for 'retirement

parts.note: Maud is a woman's name

indicators.note: retiring means withdrawing or going back, so this word is read backwards

parts.note: nil means nothing

explanation.surface: A weeping woman left with nothing to retire on.
explanation.definitionFit: Weepy and sentimentally self-pitying, as someone tipsy can become.

clue.text: Going for French and German articles on fashion

parts.note: un is a French indefinite article
der is a German definite article
a fashion is a manner or way

explanation.surface: Writing for European magazines about clothes styles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'articles' serves both languages: UN is French for 'a', DER German for 'the'.
explanation.definitionFit: A project in progress is said to be in motion, already started.

clue.text: Few cut a Liberal

parts.note: to sever is to cut
taken as written

explanation.surface: Only a handful of politicians removed a Liberal.
explanation.definitionFit: A small number more than two, a handful, means a few.

clue.text: For sale: ripe produce grown by 13 ac.

indicators.note: as a verb, to produce is to make something new, so these letters are worked into another word

explanation.surface: An advertisement offering ripe fruit raised by a nursery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'produce' looks like a noun for fruit and veg but is a verb signalling the anagram. 13 across is a plant nurseryman, who grows trained fruit trees.
explanation.definitionFit: A fruit tree trained flat against a wall or trellis is typically raised by a plant nursery professional.

clue.text: Swearing to give voice about rubbishy stuff

indicators.note: about means around, so one word goes round the other

parts.note: to sing is to give voice
tat is cheap, tasteless goods

explanation.surface: Cursing while singing about cheap junk.
explanation.definitionFit: Swearing in its sense of declaring solemnly, asserting under oath.

clue.text: Sent on plant without credit being arranged

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so one word goes round the other

parts.note: a reed is a waterside plant

indicators.note: being arranged means the letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A plant posted onward with no credit given, arranged by someone else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' wants to mean lacking; here it means outside. 'being arranged' turns CREDIT into DIRECT, which goes inside REED.
explanation.definitionFit: Mail forwarded to a new address has been sent on.

clue.text: Coppers bet for fun

parts.note: p, pence, are copper coins
to lay is to bet

explanation.surface: Police officers place a wager just for amusement.
explanation.definitionFit: Recreation and amusement are what children call play time, a synonym of fun.

clue.text: Charm a beast tigerish at first

parts.note: a mule is a beast of burden

indicators.note: at first selects the opening letter of the word before it

explanation.surface: A tigerish creature can be charmed, at least to begin with.
explanation.definitionFit: A charm is a trinket worn to ward off evil, a talisman.

clue.text: A form of support many a worker is wearing

parts.note: a bra is a supporting undergarment
D is 500 in Roman numerals, standing for many
an ant is a worker insect

explanation.surface: A worker has put on a supportive undergarment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wearing' looks like part of the dressing picture but is the definition, in its sense of wearing away.
explanation.definitionFit: An abrasive substance grinds and erodes surfaces, so it is wearing in the sense of eroding.

clue.text: A little space reserved for a maple tree

indicators.note: A little says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Only a small area set aside for planting a maple.
explanation.definitionFit: Acer is the botanical genus name for maples.

clue.text: Denominations in brief

parts.note: denominations are names, and names cut down to their opening letters are a brief form of them

explanation.surface: Sounds like a summary of church groups or currency values.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Denominations' suggests churches or banknotes but here simply means names.
explanation.definitionFit: The first letters of a person's names are an abbreviated way of writing them.

clue.text: A union measure

definitions.meaning: an alliance or association of groups
an old unit of distance, about three miles

explanation.surface: A trade union takes some action.
explanation.definitionFit: An alliance of clubs or nations, and an old measure of distance of roughly three miles.

clue.text: Reinvigorate a green tree that has been moved

indicators.note: moving the letters around puts them into a new order

explanation.surface: Advice to revive a sapling by transplanting it.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring new life and energy to something is to renew it.
